references.text: Job describes similar anxiety and unrest, lying awake at night waiting for morning without peace or rest—a state of constant fear for life.
The same theme of fear day and night, where the sound of a blowing leaf shall drive them away, and they shall flee as if fleeing from the sword.
Part of the curses in Leviticus describing a condition where life is filled with terror, weakened eyes, and a sorrowful soul.
Describes the wicked living in uncertainty, rising up without trusting their own lives—the same expression about having no confidence in one's life.
The psalmist describes a life on the brink of death, counted among those who go down to the grave—life hanging by a thread.
Jesus speaks of life as something given and taken away—connecting to the theme of life's uncertainty and that it hangs in others' hands.
